sections.title: check_exercise_completion()
sections.body:
Check if all exercises have been completed.

```python
# =============================================================================
# EXERCISE COMPLETION CHECK
# =============================================================================
def check_exercise_completion():
    """Check if all exercises have been completed."""
    exercises = [
        exercise_1_read_file('test1.txt'),
        exercise_2_count_lines('test2.txt'),
        exercise_3_longest_line('test3.txt'),
        exercise_4_word_count('test4.txt'),
        exercise_5_search_replace('test5_input.txt', 'hello', 'hi'),
        exercise_6_csv_processor('test6.csv'),
        exercise_7_json_extractor('test7.json', 'name'),
        exercise_8_create_backup('test8.txt'),
        exercise_9_log_analyzer('test9.log'),
        exercise_10_merge_files('test10a.txt', 'test10b.txt', 'test10_merged.txt')
    ]
    
    completed = sum(1 for result in exercises if result is not None)
    total = len(exercises)
    
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"EXERCISE COMPLETION SUMMARY")
    print(f"{'='*50}")
    print(f"Completed: {completed}/{total} exercises")
    print(f"Progress: {(completed/total)*100:.1f}%")
    
    if completed == total:
        print("🎉 All exercises completed! Great job!")
    elif completed > total/2:
        print("👍 Good progress! Keep going!")
    else:
        print("💪 Keep practicing! You're getting there!")
    
    return completed == total

# Run completion check
check_exercise_completion()
```
